bug_semantics: The public /api/ValidateArgumentType RPC accepted attacker-controlled binding_id and argument_name and, without calling auth.UserFromApiCall, checkDashboardAccess, or a per-action view check, looked up the server's action binding and argument configuration. With AuthRequireGuestsToLogin=true, unauthenticated callers who were denied the dashboard could still distinguish an existing binding/argument from a missing one by the RPC result (initially distinct 200 responses/descriptions, and later 200 versus CodeNotFound). Binding IDs are often predictable SHA-256 hashes of human-readable action titles, so the endpoint was an unauthenticated action/argument-enumeration oracle.
flaw_origin: Commit 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d changed the existing stateless UI helper from TypeSafetyCheck over caller-supplied value/type into binding-aware validation: it called api.executor.FindBindingByID(req.Msg.BindingId), searched binding.Action.Arguments for req.Msg.ArgumentName, returned existence-dependent responses, and called executor.ValidateArgument, but added no authentication, dashboard-access, or action-view authorization. The pre-existing unauthenticated type-only endpoint did not consult server action configuration and therefore was not yet the advisory's enumeration oracle; 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d is the smallest causal introducer rather than the later helper refactor or error-handling change.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d shows author jamesread <contact@jread.com>, committer jamesread <contact@jread.com>, one parent, and only the subject 'fix: Argument validation targets the bindings (fixes checkboxes, etc)'; there is no Co-Authored-By trailer, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, AI attribution, or any other trailer in the BIC commit object.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/security/advisories/GHSA-f637-w7p2-m7fx identifies service/internal/api/api.go:ValidateArgumentType, explains that the missing auth/dashboard check bypasses AuthRequireGuestsToLogin, documents the 200-versus-NotFound argument oracle and predictable binding IDs, and recommends adding auth.UserFromApiCall plus checkDashboardAccess.

At 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d, service/internal/httpservers/frontend.go:45-64 maps public /api/<method> requests into the Connect handler; service/gen/olivetin/api/v1/apiv1connect/olivetin.connect.go:66-68 declares /olivetin.api.v1.OliveTinApiService/ValidateArgumentType and lines 555-558 bind it to svc.ValidateArgumentType. proto/olivetin/api/v1/olivetin.proto:164-171 supplies binding_id, argument_name, value, and type.

git log -L on service/internal/api/api.go:ValidateArgumentType traces the causal addition to 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d. Its one-file 38-addition/1-deletion patch at service/internal/api/api.go:594-638 adds FindBindingByID, the Action.Arguments name search, existence-dependent descriptions, and executor.ValidateArgument while leaving the handler without auth.UserFromApiCall or checkDashboardAccess.

Direct-parent tree verification: git show 5d061eb1a0ddf7649d451051d8cad5668b09b341:service/internal/api/api.go at the same ValidateArgumentType block shows only executor.TypeSafetyCheck('', req.Msg.Value, req.Msg.Type) and a Valid/Description response. It contains none of the binding lookup, action-argument search, or binding-dependent branches added by the BIC. The vulnerable mechanism is therefore absent from the immediate parent even though the harmless type-only helper itself is older.

Lifecycle cross-check: 8e2db0ad82e73da5a2484498f79c8cfeaf88a3d9 immediately refactored the new binding-aware logic into validateArgumentTypeInternal, and bb14c5da3e64b03f207c7f38139eb60e97c278fc later made missing bindings/arguments return one CodeNotFound error. Neither removed the unauthenticated success-versus-not-found oracle, so neither is the BIC or fix.

Attack precondition and predictability are source-backed: service/internal/api/api.go:433-438 at the BIC defines checkDashboardAccess to reject guests when AuthRequireGuestsToLogin is true, but ValidateArgumentType did not call it; service/internal/auth/authcheck.go:45-68 maps a request with no authenticated identity to UserGuest; service/internal/executor/executor_actions.go:132-148 derives an ID from action.ID or SHA-256(action.Title, optionally entity-qualified).

Direct fix https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/commit/a3865704c854061452a4ab5f6d95de3312698ccd (parent 61593a8aaf1fa1f6019e13871572d39cf2c226c6) adds auth.UserFromApiCall and checkDashboardAccess to ValidateArgumentType, then validateArgumentTypeBindingAccess/errUnlessUserMayValidateArgumentTypeForBinding with userCanViewAction enforcement in service/internal/api/api.go; it also adds regression coverage for denied guests, denied view permission, and permitted users in service/internal/api/api_test.go.

reasoning: The advisory's security boundary is not merely that ValidateArgumentType was callable without login; the endpoint became dangerous when it began consulting private server bindings and arguments and returning existence-dependent results. History separates those events cleanly. The original Connect handler and direct parent 5d061eb1a0ddf7649d451051d8cad5668b09b341 only type-checked caller-provided data. The single-parent, one-file commit 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d first joined unauthenticated input to FindBindingByID and Action.Arguments and exposed the result, so it is the smallest BIC; the direct-parent tree proves that mechanism absent. Later commits only moved the code or changed missing-object error behavior. The BIC lands before the earliest containing stable tag 3000.8.0, persists through 3000.12.0, and direct fix a3865704c854061452a4ab5f6d95de3312698ccd adds both the guest/dashboard gate and per-action view authorization before first fixed tag 3000.13.0. Finally, attribution is judged solely from the BIC commit object: its human author/committer and trailer-free message contain no AI marker, requiring NOT_AI.
